rationale: Zone 1 set to 81.5% of protected line impedance (26.386 Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 55% of shortest backup line L_BC (15.772 Ω). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 122.5% of longest backup line L_BD (18.552 Ω), well below load encroachment limit of ~121 Ω. Delays set to minimum values within coordination windows.
